children: Russia ran a budget deficit of 5.8 trillion roubles($67.76 billion), or 2.5% of gross domestic product, in the eight months of the year, down from 6.46 trillion roubles, 2.8% of GDP a month earlier, the finance ministry said on Wednesday, citing preliminary data.

The budget deficit narrowed thanks to the payment of state-owned banks' dividends in August. At the same time, the budget deficit remained 48% higher than the same period last year and 53% higher than the annual plan.
Federal budget revenues from the beginning of the year rose 9.2% year-on-year, while expenditures increased 14.7%.
